text:
olivia: Quick festive idea — fireplace Zoom background + 3pm kitchen toast today? Also a tiny cookie photo contest. post a pic of your cookie or mug and we'll vote :fireplace: :cookie: :tada:
aj: I'm in. can we do a 'best microwaved mug cake' category? :grimacing: 3pm works for me.
devon: Love it. bringing hot cider. who wants to join the mini playlist? i can drop one in #random-playlists.
maria: Ooh vote idea — use reactions. thumbs = best cookie, heart = best mug, :clapping: = best presentation.
olivia: Nice. I'll kick it off with a poll command so it's fast:
```
/poll "3pm toast + cookie pics?" "Yes!" "No, lunchtime person" "Maybe"
```
ken: Posting a pic of my infamous ginger snaps in 2. Also will join the toast. :camera_with_flash:
holiday-bot: Reminder: virtual toast & cookie pics at 15:00 UTC. Use #random for uploads. Prize: bragging rights + an e-gift sticker.
maria: Uploaded — see pic. (not shown here) :cookie::sparkles:
aj: Uploaded my sad microwave mug cake. labeling it: "rustic abstraction" :joy:
devon: Vote time! my vote on ken's snaps = :thumbsup: very pro.
olivia: Ok folks, 15:00 in 10m. Fireplace background link: https://tiny.redwood/virt-fireplace (pinning it). Bring your cup. :clinking_glasses:
ken: Also quick logistics — anyone want me to swing by HQ and drop off extra cookies for those on site? i can put them by kitchen around 2:45.
maria: yes please, ppl in office will love you. i'll bring napkins. :raised_hands:
aj: Can't make it in person but i'll be there on video with light-up mug. :sparkles:
holiday-bot: Event ended: 15:20 UTC. Winners by reactions: best cookie = ken, best mug = aj, best presentation = maria. Congrats! :trophy:
